cases.name: Anna Jane Brown
cases.about: Anna was reportedly a devoted mother to 3 daughters, the dog warden and she loved volunteering at her local ambulance squad .
cases.narrative:
She was sexually assaulted and stabbed to death while her children were at school. At 3:30 p.m. when her daughter came home from school she found her mother laying down and told her older sister over the phone that she couldn't wake their mother up. Barbara, the older of Anna’s daughters, quickly went over to the home on Summitville road, where she found her little sister and their mother deceased on the floor in the foyer.

Brown was reportedly brutally murdered with steak knives, sustaining more than 21 stab wounds reported. There was also evidence of a sexual assault as her pants and under garments were pulled down and her shirt was pushed up .
